title: stelis pubescens
intro: Stelis pubescens, commonly known as "Pitahaya Blanca" or "White Dragon Fruit," is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions and has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Stelis pubescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and immune system modulation. The therapeutic actions of Stelis pubescens also include its potential to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit antidiabetic and hepatoprotective effects.
